WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, st.format, st.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
), r AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.format, s.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT (s.receipt_id, s.line_no)) dist_lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) refunded, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0)/sum(s.net_amount)*100 pct, coalesce(sum(r.qty),0)*100.0/sum(s.quantity) unit_pct
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH p AS (SELECT min(calendar_date) a, max(calendar_date) b FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2),
sold AS (
  SELECT st.format, sum(f.net_amount) sold FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.a AND p.b AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT st.format, sum(r.refund_net) refunded FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN p.a AND p.b AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
booked AS (
  SELECT st.format, sum(r.refund_net) booked FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key, p
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN p.a AND p.b AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT a FROM p) a, (SELECT b FROM p) b, sold.format, sold.sold, ret.refunded, round(ret.refunded/sold.sold*100,2) cohort_pct, booked.booked, round(booked.booked/sold.sold*100,2) booked_pct
FROM sold JOIN ret USING (format) JOIN booked USING (format) ORDER BY 3
